svg.text: Cordless wiring — keep the battery's white JST plug

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Golf-tracker doctrine: never cut the battery — a replaceable LiPo is a feature. A JST switch cable does the same job with HALF the

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: glue joints, because the switch is already wired inline: nothing to wrap, nothing to clip. You cut the CABLE's far end, not the cell.

svg.text: Works fine — it is simply more joints to get right, and the cell is committed to this build once it's glued on.

svg.text: NEGATIVE is the pad closest to USB-C.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Positive is the pad farther away. Confirm on your own board

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: before gluing — reversing it kills the XIAO.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠ Meter the cut end — don't trust wire colours

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: JST housings are not wired to a universal convention, so the red

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wire at the cut end is not proof of anything. Plug the battery in,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: switch ON, and meter the two bare ends before either one touches a pad.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Cable: Adafruit #3064 "JST 2-pin Extension Cable with On/Off Switch" (JST-PH 2.0, 22 AWG, ~20 in) — battery plugs into its socket end; trim the rest to length.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Mount the switch and the plug junction on the OUTSIDE of the pod's rear end wall (the pod is an open tray, so the wires just cross the wall top).

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • USB-C still charges the cell through the cable; leave the switch ON to charge. The firmware never sleeps (~60–100 mA idle) — that's what the switch is for.
